$comment: School newsletters read from each school's public ParentSquare widget (the 'Weekly Updates' page on the school site). ParentSquare's terms require the owner's written consent to reuse post content, and the owner is the school — so a newsletter is enabled only once its principal has agreed, and the consent is recorded here. Nothing is copied verbatim: only dates, short topic names, action links and a link back to the full post.

newsletters.name: The Hammerschmidt Star
newsletters.consent: Principal David Danielski agreed to experimental use, per the site owner, 2026-09-22.
